Subject: Activation Play & Cutover Windows — Tidewell Health MAP v1

Hi Maria / Tidewell implementation team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, I’m attaching a first-draft mutual action plan that breaks the onboarding into four milestone clusters: Prep & Access, Integration, Validation & Pilot, and Cutover & Hypercare. The doc includes proposed owners and tentative dates — we intentionally left a two-week buffer between Validation and Cutover to account for scheduling and any remediation.

As next steps:
- Can you confirm whether the Tidewell infra team can provide sandbox API credentials by Sept 15?
- Please confirm preferred weekly cadence for the next 6 weeks (we suggested Tuesdays at 10am PT).
- Any legal/PO timing issues we should account for before Cutover?

I’ve copied Lauren (CS lead) and Sergio (solutions/infra) who will own different pieces of the MAP. I’ll consolidate any timing changes and push a v1.1 by end of week.

Attachment: Tidewell_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, artifacts)
Attachment: Redwood_SOW_v0.3.pdf (draft, not final)

Best,
Jordan Blake

Jordan — thanks for the draft. Quick answers:
- Sandbox API creds: yes, we can hand those over by Wed 9/15. I’ve asked Dave (cc: impl-team) to take point.
- Weekly cadence: Tues 1pm ET works for our PM and Clinical Ops (that’s your 10am PT suggestion; good).
- PO/legal: procurement is moving the PO internally; I expect it to be approved by week of Sept 27 but will flag immediately if anything slips.

I’ll review the MAP and provide comments inline by EOD Thursday. We do have a mandatory security questionnaire (third party risk) that our security team will need answered before Cutover — I’ll attach that separately.

Great — thanks Maria. Noted on the security questionnaire. Lauren / Sergio — can you two pick up the items below so I can reflect owners in v1.1?

Lauren: please confirm the CS Kickoff and initial success criteria owner(s). We proposed Lauren and Sarah Kim (CS Manager) for weekly runbook reviews and acceptance criteria signoff. If that’s OK, we’ll list Sarah as the primary.

Sergio: we need an infra checklist itemized: sandbox IP allowlist, expected peak RPS for pilot, and whether we’ll require a dedicated VPC peering. Goal is to lock that by Sept 14 to avoid delays.

Also attaching a provisional cutover calendar (cutover_calendar.ics) with two candidate weekend windows (Oct 23–24 and Oct 30–31). Please confirm preferences — these are intentionally staggered in case we need rollback time.

I’ll push v1.1 on Friday with any edits.

Regards,
Jordan
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@tidewell.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, impl-team@tidewell.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation Play & Cutover Windows — Tidewell Health MAP v1

Thanks — quick infra notes from my side:
- Sandbox onboarding: Tidewell needs to provide a CIDR range for allowlisting and a service account for API tokens. Once we have the token, we’ll validate token scopes within 24 hours.
- Pilot load: for the initial pilot please plan for 150 concurrent users, peak ~12RPS sustained. If you anticipate higher, flag now — quantization and batching profiles will change performance estimates.
- VPC peering: not required for pilot; recommended for Post-Go-Live for throughput and compliance. If Tidewell wants encrypted private connectivity for Prod, we can provision a dedicated VPC peering or PrivateLink.

I’ll prepare a short infra checklist and drop in the shared Drive by EOD.

—Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

Maria — welcome, and glad we’re aligned on cadence. Two small asks from CS before I finalize the acceptance criteria:
1) Can Tidewell identify two internal stakeholders who will sign UAT acceptance? We generally want one clinical ops and one engineering sign-off.
2) Are there any blackout dates in October we should avoid for Pilot or Cutover (major EMR maintenance, town halls, etc.)?

If you can send stakeholder names and any blackout dates by Monday 9/13, I’ll lock the Acceptance & Pilot milestone and circulate the updated MAP + a short playbook (1 page) that lists runbook owners and rollback triggers.

Attachment: (none) — will reference files in shared drive.

Thanks — Lauren
